requirements.title: Admin-created offer is visible to chosen seller
requirements.given: Authorized admin selects seller A and a published Catalog variant from the existing admin navigation
requirements.when: Admin creates one draft Offer and independently reopens it
requirements.then: Offer.SellerPartyId=A, single stable OfferId, seller A list/detail shows the same OfferId; seller B does not; no Catalog mutation

requirements.title: Role and owner authorization on every command
requirements.given: Admin edit rights, admin view-only rights, sellers A and B have distinct authorized identities
requirements.when: Each reads/creates/edits offer and directly invokes owning APIs including price/inventory
requirements.then: Only authorized roles and owner scope succeed; B cannot read/change A; view-only cannot write price/inventory/create; denied requests make zero persisted changes
requirements.proof: Real Host authenticated/authorized negative API + SQL and browser

requirements.title: Create can resume without duplicate Offer
requirements.given: A multi-step Create has written Offer but Pricing or Inventory failed, or response was lost
requirements.when: Same operator reconnects, retries or resumes the saved intent
requirements.then: Reconciliation with authoritative GET/owned listing returns original OfferId, follows remaining incomplete steps; never blindly posts second Create or duplicates price/inventory effects; Draft is not falsely ready
requirements.proof: Connected browser→Host→isolated PostgreSQL; injected controlled error branch only with real first write

requirements.title: Published Catalog picker supports server search and paging beyond 100
requirements.given: At least 150 published products plus multiple variants and at least one older item beyond newest 100
requirements.when: Admin or seller searches exact old product/variant and pages through the picker
requirements.then: Correct result appears from server, not from loaded first 100; stable pages, total/count/hasMore grounded; selection maintained across paging/search/errors; non-published excluded
requirements.proof: Real Catalog query/provider PostgreSQL + Chromium, request paging assertions

requirements.title: Offer list uses real server paging and search for both roles
requirements.given: At least 200 seller offers with distinct search keys and multiple sellers
requirements.when: Seller and authorized admin search, sort and paginate
requirements.then: Server applies owner-scoped filtering/query, stable deterministic order and bounded pages; totals accurate, no full-array fetch or client-only filtering; empty/error/loading distinct
requirements.proof: Real Host PostgreSQL indexed pagination / request trace + browser

requirements.title: Safe cancel, malformed result, failed continuation and status
requirements.given: Draft create or existing resumable workflow has unsaved edits or partial progress
requirements.when: Cancel, disconnect, malformed/wrong seller response, permission refusal and retry occur
requirements.then: Cancel before first write yields zero business writes; no false success; partial progress is explicitly disclosed and recoverable via same OfferId; status stays Draft until appropriate owning prerequisites; no accidental duplication
requirements.proof: Connected success and controlled error branches with independent GET+SQL

requirements.title: Usable Persian FA/EN role experiences, real Impeccable critique
requirements.given: Admin and seller forms are loaded at 360x640 and desktop in fa and en
requirements.when: Operator selects seller, searches picker, fills Draft, saves/resumes, navigates to list/detail
requirements.then: Existing shells/design system, proper RTL/LTR, registry languages not hard-coded authority, clear words for non-engineers, accessible 44px primary controls, no horizontal overflow, mobile keyboard/reopen and error feedback; documented Impeccable before/after critique
requirements.proof: Impeccable critique log + served Chromium geometry/interactions

requirements.title: No domain ownership or roadmap drift and deterministic delivery
requirements.given: Catalog, Offer, Pricing, Inventory, Party and AccessControl remain owning domains
requirements.then: No unsafe cross-domain write or schema migration without approved contract; no Stage3 shipping or discounts; strict OpenSpec and task-specific OpenCode verifier with negative self-tests; code/build hashes, cleanup, all REQs independently reviewed
requirements.proof: Diff/contract audit, strict spec, reproducible verifier, connected evidence and rollback
